LanguageData.BWT_Worktype_Desc: Limit this rule to one Work type.
LanguageData.BWT_AllowOverwritingHigherPriority_Desc: By default the highest priority is kept. This allows later rules to overwrite higher priority.
LanguageData.BWT_HasHighestSkill_Desc: Assign pawns tied for the highest relevant skill. Vanilla instead assigns one random starting pawn to each Work type.

LanguageData.BWT_IsNaturalAlwaysAssign_Desc: Assign only if vanilla marks this Work type as always assigned.
LanguageData.BWT_RandomIfMultiple_Desc: When multiple colonists match this Work type, assign one at random.
LanguageData.BWT_IgnoreIfWorktypeNonexistent_Desc: Skip this rule when the Work type is unavailable, such as when a mod is missing.
LanguageData.BWT_IsTopXSkill_Desc: Assign when this Work type is among the colonist's top X skills. Vanilla uses the top six.
LanguageData.BWT_IsNthBestPawn_Desc: Assign only if the colonist ranks exactly Nth for this Work type.
LanguageData.BWT_IsNthBestSkill_Desc: Assign only if this Work type is the colonist's Nth-best skill.
LanguageData.BWT_LimitNumberOfWorktypes_Desc: Assign only if the colonist has fewer than this many assigned Work types.
LanguageData.BWT_SkipIfPriorityForThisWorktypeAreadyA: Assign only if this priority is not already set for this Work type.
LanguageData.BWT_PassionLevel_Desc: Assign only if the colonist's relevant passion for this Work type matches the selected level.
LanguageData.BWT_SkillLevelGreaterThan_Desc: Assign only if the colonist's skill for this Work type is above this value.
LanguageData.BWT_SkillLevelLessThan_Desc: Assign only if the colonist's skill for this Work type is below this value.
LanguageData.BWT_MoveSpeedGreaterThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's move speed is greater than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_MoveSpeedLessThan_Desc: Only assign if the pawn's move speed is less than this number.
LanguageData.BWT_Gender_Desc: Only assign to pawns of this gender.
LanguageData.BWT_Xenotype_Desc: Only assign to pawns with this xenotype.
LanguageData.BWT_RequiredTrait_Desc: Only assign to pawns with this trait.
LanguageData.BWT_AssignSimilarWorktypes_Desc: Also assign this rule to Work types that use the same relevant skills.
LanguageData.BWT_FailedToApplyFallback_Desc: Apply this rule if the primary rule did not assign any pawns.

LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_Welcome_Body: This tour covers what Better Work Tab adds to RimWorld's Work tab. Pause any time and return when you are ready.
LanguageData.BWT_Upgrade20_PromptBody: Better Work Tab is now 2.0. Your settings are unchanged, and new features start disabled. See what is new?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_ActiveBody: Fluffy Work Tab is active. Better Work Tab checked for compatible hourly priorities without changing visual or Work-tab ownership settings. Review compatibility settings?
LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_HistoricalBody: This save contains Fluffy Work Tab data. Better Work Tab imported compatible hourly priorities without changing visual or Work-tab ownership settings. Review compatibility settings?

LanguageData.BWT_FluffyMigration_SettingsContextToolt: Settings for Fluffy-style controls, saved hourly priorities, visible compatibility columns, and choosing which mod owns the Work tab.

LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_PawnAppearance_Outcome: Row updated. Display only, the colonist is unchanged.

LanguageData.BWT_Tutorial_HeaderSubWork_Outcome: Specific jobs open. Escape or {0} returns.

Higher skill numbers help you compare who is naturally better at that Work. Keep holding Shift while you look. Release it when you are ready to return to priorities.
